body:
### Fixed

- [`adr-template.md`](https://github.com/adr/madr/tree/4.0.0/template/adr-template.md): Re-add quotes around chosen option name.
- [`adr-template-minimal.md`](https://github.com/adr/madr/tree/4.0.0/template/adr-template-minimal.md): Place holder in one line.
- [`adr-template-bare.md`](https://github.com/adr/madr/tree/4.0.0/template/adr-template-bare.md): Keep fixed template text as normal markdown (and not as comment).
- `adr-template-bare.md` and [`adr-template-bare-minimal.md`](https://github.com/adr/madr/tree/4.0.0/template/adr-template-bare-minimal.md): Always use `<!-- … ->` als place holder instead of `{…}`.

See https://github.com/adr/madr/tree/4.0.0/template for the list of all templates.
